title: Outcome-Based Wisdom-Services Pricing Contract (OPX-1)
description: Prices a customer engagement as a risk-adjusted, receipted value-transfer and splits it across the provider mesh, settled on a real-asset-backed token unit. Consumes the economic-prophet spine (EP kernel, RM-1 risk measures, IC-1 conservation settlement, TC-1 term calculus, Fisher-real separation, ALC-1 Jacob's ladder) by reference, and the-assay / counter-test-gate / GKN standing as graded provenance. Measurement, simulation and audit only: no live money movement, token issuance, redemption rights, or settlement rails. NOTE: the pricing engine is the authority on the controlled vocabularies (IBM value drivers, assay grades, coherent risk kernels); this schema documents the shape.

outcome_receipt.description: The teeth-gate: a price MUST be contingent on a verified outcome-receipt. Without verified==true and a receipt_id, this is time-and-materials, not outcome-based, and is REJECTED.

value_drivers.description: IBM Customer-Transformation value-driver tree branches. Each present driver moves its EP-kernel component from baseline to post; V = Delta(EP) via uvmc.reconcile_ep_components.

knowledge.description: Value-of-Information (truth price), graded by the-assay 5-axis verdict.

assay_grade.description: Projected the-assay grade: certified->full VoI, speculative->discounted, false->clawback.

priced_voi.description: The truth price actually charged; must be <= the graded VoI ceiling.

speculative_discount.description: Required for speculative grade; fraction of raw VoI withheld (in [0,1)).

clawback.description: Required true for a false grade; books the reversal.

risk.description: RAROC over the outcome distribution F_outcome. EconomicCapital = coherent-tail(F).

kernel.description: Must be a COHERENT tail kernel; non-coherent measures cannot gate capital.

outcome_samples.description: Realised-outcome value samples; E[V] = mean, EconomicCapital = ES/spectral over the loss side.

hurdle_rate.description: RAROC hurdle; price ~ E[V] - hurdle * EconomicCapital.

discount.description: Fisher-real discount over horizon tau plus a 3-T boundary-complexity friction.

equilibrium.description: Nash / Pareto bargaining split between the provider cost-floor and client value-ceiling (welfare-annealing at transaction scale).

mesh.description: Euler / marginal-contribution allocation of P across providers (Sum == P via IC-1 settlement), settled on a real-asset-backed token unit.

explicit_allocations.description: If true, each provider's 'allocation' is settled verbatim (not normalised); a split whose shares do not sum to P is REJECTED by the IC-1 conservation settlement.

asset_ladder_rung.description: The Jacob's-ladder (ALC-1) real-asset rung grounding the token unit.

marginal_contribution.description: Euler share of the value the provider helped create.

allocation.description: Only for explicit_allocations mode: this provider's share of P, settled verbatim.
